summary: StockHoroscope UX enhancements on /neutools/horo — FRONTEND ONLY testing per request. All 4 features PASS end-to-end: (1) Dynamic StockDNA auto-pick banner reappears whenever pick === dnaArchetype (not just initial mount); (2) Per-archetype info modal opens via ⓘ icon and PICK THIS button switches active pick; (3) 30-sec 4-question mini-quiz selects winner and auto-closes; (4) PDF export downloads multi-page client-side jsPDF file. Page renders WHAT/WHY/HOW + interactive HoroscopeUI. All 8 investor archetypes + 8 info-icon tiles present (visionary, analyst, maverick, steady, explorer, guardian, strategist, timelord). EN primary tested; ID smoke confirmed banner translates to 'Dipersonalisasi dari hasil StockDNA Anda — SI VISIONER'. Zero console errors/warnings across full flow. Market-pulse pill rendered LIVE (VIX: 17.19, S&P 5D: +2.33%, IHSG 5D: +0.18% from yfinance) so graceful-degradation path not exercised in this session.

issues: The card has no explicit 'Celestial Signal' or 'Fortune' section labels — the brief describes these as named sections but the implementation renders the celestial-signal content as an italic blockquote at the top (no 'Celestial Signal' header) and the fortune line as a star-bracketed centred line (no 'Fortune' header). All 5 OTHER labelled sections (YOUR GUIDANCE, POWER MOVE, AVOID TODAY, LUCKY SECTOR, UNLUCKY SECTOR) ARE rendered with their labels. Cosmetic only — content is present and correctly archetype-specific. Consider adding small CELESTIAL SIGNAL / FORTUNE eyebrow labels for consistency with the other 5 sections.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): Add CELESTIAL SIGNAL and FORTUNE eyebrow labels to horo-card to match the labelling of the other 5 sections (YOUR GUIDANCE, POWER MOVE, AVOID TODAY, LUCKY SECTOR, UNLUCKY SECTOR). Currently those two blocks render as unlabelled italic-quote and centred-star-line. Not blocking — content is correctly archetype-specific and the brief's intent (display celestial+fortune content) is met.
critical_code_review_comments: Banner dynamic-reappear logic correctly ties visibility to pick === dnaArchetype rather than initial-mount-only — verified by switch-then-repick cycle. Good.

PDF filename includes UPPER_CASE archetype name with underscores ('StockHoroscope_THE_VISIONARY_2026-05-11.pdf') — readable, ISO date suffix is great for sorting. jsPDF generation is fully client-side (no server round-trip) — fast and offline-friendly.

Reading card content body doesn't echo archetype name back to the user — that's fine because the active tile is gold-highlighted, but it makes regression testing harder. Suggestion: add the archetype name as a data attribute on horo-card (e.g., data-archetype='maverick') so tests can assert which reading is active without OCR-style content sniffing.

Info modal copy is rich (tagline + summary + traits + best-at + avoid + risk tolerance) — well-curated. ID translations confirmed at least for the banner ('SI VISIONER', 'SI MAVERICK', 'SI ANALIS', 'SI TANGAN KOKOH', 'SI PENJELAJAH', 'SI PENJAGA', 'SI AHLI STRATEGI', 'SI TUAN WAKTU' — full coverage on tiles).
Quiz auto-closes on 4th selection and updates pick atomically — no flash of empty state, no leftover focus issues.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 acceptance criteria pass; 1 minor cosmetic label suggestion)

N/A — no product defects. Verified pick-switch actually works via direct screenshot inspection (THE MAVERICK tile gold-highlighted + Maverick-specific copy 'Mars ignites — the contrarian window opens').

Only minor cosmetic gap: 'Celestial Signal' and 'Fortune' section labels are not rendered as explicit eyebrow headers (the content for both is present — italic quote + star-bracketed centred line — just without the labels). The brief describes them as named sections; the implementation chose label-less stylised treatment. Non-blocking.
